limitations: FP32 Adam moment rounding and FP32 clip implementation prevent exact signed gradient recovery
Aggregate across an optimizer group only;cannot separate per-image or positive/native/source contributions
AdamW weight decay is decoupled and is not a loss gradient
No activation tensors or model forward inferred from moments
c11.method: g_clipped approximately equals (Adam_exp_avg_t-beta1*exp_avg_previous)/(1-beta1);undo clip factor from recorded preclip norms;subtract analytic L2-SP gradient forC13
